heading: A Happy Start to a Lifetime of Grooming
blockquote: Your puppy’s first grooming visits are about building trust, not creating the perfect haircut.
body:
We encourage owners to introduce puppies to the salon from around four months old, once their vaccinations are complete. These early appointments help puppies become familiar with the sights, sounds, equipment and handling involved in professional grooming.

Everything is introduced gradually and positively so your puppy can build confidence at their own pace. We also work closely with you, sharing simple guidance on brushing, handling paws and ears, and maintaining the coat at home. A calm introduction now can make grooming easier and happier throughout your dog’s life.
